name: findings-presentation
description: Structure a consulting findings presentation using the Pyramid Principle storyline. Use when a consultant says "help me structure my presentation", "I have findings and need to present them", "how do I structure the deck", "build me the storyline", "help me tell the story of the findings", "I have data but no narrative", "client presentation is next week", "how do I present recommendations to the steering committee", or "the deck needs a through-line". Also trigger when someone has completed analysis and needs to communicate findings and recommendations to senior client stakeholders in a structured, persuasive format.
